biggest_catch: Toluna points are worth a fraction of a cent each (~3,000 points = $1), and the 30,000-point ($10) minimum means weeks of surveys before your first payout.
catches: Point value is tiny: ~3,000 points = $1, so a 500-point survey pays about 17 cents (per current panel guides).
Minimum redemption is 30,000 points ($10) for gift cards; PayPal needs more (65,000+ points per community sources) — confirm in your account before counting on it.
Rewards can take up to 3 weeks to arrive after requesting.
Most people get screened out of most surveys — unpaid qualifying time is the main cost.
Points-to-cash rates and the reward catalog vary by country.
